# Mercari's 10% fee reaches your shipping too.

> Free Mercari seller fee calculator for the current schedule (10% on item price + buyer-paid shipping, effective Jan 6 2025) and the legacy pre-2025 schedule (10% on item price plus 2.9%+$0.50 processing). Real profit, price for a target profit, and which schedule pays more. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
